summary: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (RDACU/RDAC/RDACR), filed an 8-K reporting two unsecured promissory notes issued to SZG Limited, designee of merger counterparty HZJL Cayman Limited, under the January 27, 2025 merger agreement. The August 15 and September 15 notes each total $55,637.41, bear no interest, and mature upon consummation of the initial business combination; proceeds funded trust-account deposits extending the combination deadline to October 15, 2026. The holder may convert the notes into private units at $10.00 per unit. Watch for further extensions, conversion elections, and whether the deal closes before the deadline, given redemption-overhang risk.
